ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass WSReset
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass via WSReset usable by default sysmon-config

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\wsreset\\\.exe$") AND (process_integrity_level = "High" OR process_integrity_level = "System" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-16384" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-12288"))
